instruction: A clean studio portrait of two women against a solid dusty rose wall. On the left, the straight-haired woman in a denim jacket (R2) looks directly at the camera. Behind her, the curly-haired woman in a black tank top (R3) stands close, resting her hand on the other's shoulder while looking slightly down. Soft, diffused studio lighting creates a warm, minimalist aesthetic.
